Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

come here phrase

also come here this minute!, come over here

classical

Verg. Ecl. 7, 8–9, via Ranieri

Ōcius hūc ades!

come here, quickly!

Other words

  • Concēde hūc! — come over here!

    also used · classical · Plaut. Men. 1.2.48: concēde hūc ā foribus (Lewis & Short s.v. concēdō); Traupman 95; Traupman 294

Examples

  • Concēde hūc āctūtum!

    Come here this minute!Traupman 95

  • Venī (venīte) hūc.

    Come here.Traupman 33

See also be quiet.
